title: The sprint review's reviewer writes its findings in its final text, so the orchestrator reads them without resuming it
goal: the sprint skill's review step (and any tool that writes the reviewer's brief) tells the headless reviewer to put every finding in its final answer text and never only through a findings tool, since claude -p --output-format json keeps only the final text in result; in SP-rlincemn the reviewer reported through ReportFindings and the orchestrator had to resume its session to read the 11 findings

run: import sys;t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();s=t[t.index('## review'):t.index('## close')];sys.exit(0 if 'final answer' in s or 'final text' in s else 1)
